title: console(grid): density / row-height change is saved as a flat top-level rowHeight on the whole served view envelope — the save door drops it with 200 and the density reverts on reload
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 · records-forms.grid-personalization · acceptance[1]

Clause A2 of `records-forms.grid-personalization` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF3, RUNNER rule 7; live twice, plus code) confirmed it: P2. It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui. The server drop is by design, so the fix is client-side. An optional framework follow-up: the save answer could flag discarded undeclared envelope keys.

## Reproduction

1. Stock showcase, admin. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task` (also reproduced on `…/view/showcase_task.grid`).
2. Click "Density: Compact (click to cycle)". It changes to "Comfortable" and rows go from 41 px to 45 px.
3. Wire: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` → 200 "Saved customization overlay". The body is the full served item (`config{…}`, `_provenance`, `scope`, `_diagnostics`) plus a flat `"rowHeight":"medium"`.
4. Server truth: `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` has no `rowHeight`, either at top level or in `config`.
5. Reload in a fresh context. Expected: Comfortable. Actual: "Density: Compact" and 41 px rows.
6. Control: a PUT with `config.rowHeight:"tall"` reads back `"rowHeight":"tall"`.

## Mechanism

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1181` `buildPersistedViewBody` returns `{ ...baseViewDef, ...patch }` for a view the switcher classes as saved. That is the whole served ViewItem `{name, object, viewKind, config:{…}}` with `rowHeight` (set at `ObjectView.tsx:2985-2991`) spread at the envelope top level instead of into `config`.
- The framework save door stores only the declared keys of a view body (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` ~757-765, ADR-0005 appendix (c), #20051 / #20868, pre-17.6.0), so it drops the key.
- `sort` / `hiddenFields` patches probably share the loss (not driven).
- The code is identical at `31971ff1e`. Nearest precedent: closed #7494 (different, org-wide scope).

## Done when

The density patch is persisted inside `config`, so it survives reload (pinned), for both stock and saved views.
